_doc: OT ROM_CTRL. No interrupts; one alert via alert_tx. TWO top-level TL-UL targets: regs_tl (CSRs: FATAL_ALERT_CAUSE, DIGEST_0..7, EXP_DIGEST_0..7) and rom_tl (the scrambled-ROM read window) — the machine maps them at separate bases. kmac_data_o/i is the hardware-app request/response pair toward kmac (cSHAKE-256 of the ROM image at boot); in the QEMU integration it becomes a generated-to-generated signal-level link. pwrmgr_data_o carries the boot done/good handshake. rom_cfg_i is a test-mode config, tied 0.
